Show me the fruits
of your 3 years
of training, Goku.

[Kami]
You trained hard
for 3 years.
Earth needs you.
Good luck, Goku!
[Mr. Popo]\nI made it.\nKami gave it life.

I'm getting rusty.
I will go train at
the Lookout!

guard to block

Clear more levels\nto raise your ki.

dodge to evade
Copy Goku attacks.

move the cursor to
the right!
